integration_suite.description: Browser smoke harnesses (self-managed dev server + headless Chromium) covering the five build milestones. These are Phase-6 integration/E2E evidence and are executed in the Phase-6 browser matrix. They are excluded from the Phase-5 G30 re-execution set because each boots a server and a browser (~14s each, ~71s total) and cannot finish inside the guard 30s per-gate wrapper; the deterministic unit suite above covers Phase-5.

note: tests_run/passed/failed are file-level counts matching the re-execution oracle; subtests carries per-case detail. Fingerprint = sha256 over all fields except fingerprint (sorted keys, 2-space).
